entity.summary: Non-custodial wallet ecosystem for Polkadot, Substrate and EVM-compatible networks, distributed through browser and mobile applications.
entity.notes: Current first-party documentation describes SubWallet as non-custodial and documents user-controlled wallet credentials. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Current SubWallet non-custodial browser extension for Polkadot, Substrate and EVM-compatible networks.
products.notes: Selected browser-extension boundary only; SubWallet mobile is deferred. Exact initial extension launch date remains unresolved.
